Karnataka CM Warns of Severe Drought, Water and Power Crisis

Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah has stated that the state is facing a severe drought, warning of potential drinking water and power shortages. The state government is preparing for these challenges. The announcement comes as August retail inflation in India rose to 4.82%.
